verdict.detail: The same year as the first issue (US, KC 32766, 1973).

notes.text:
Original first European release.
Orange CBS labels.
No LC.
No price code.

Subsequent copies with a stickered price code CB 271 do exist.

Recorded in August of 1973, in Central Park by Location.

On back cover:
Excerpt from "My Flute" by Sri Chinmoy
© 1972 by SRI Chinmoy Lighthouse

Star cluster - artwork courtesy The American Museum / Hayden Planetarium

℗ 1973 CBS Inc. / 
NL printed in Holland

On center labels:
℗ 1973 CBS, Inc.
Made in Holland

Matrix cat# etched except for variant 2: P AL 32766-1F 15 stamped.
